BL-817 — Six step handlers start tmux servers with terminal-step cleanup only, so a mutation pass leaks them — adopt BL-458's shared reaper
What it solves: Sibling context: BL-458 (the shared reaper), BL-413 (sandbox sweep boundary),
BL-486 (orphaned agent process reaping) — and BL-807, whose hardening pass
surfaced this.
Approval context: Raised as a `rule_proposal` by the hardener (scope `role:hardender`, 2026-08-05) after its BL-807 pass: 22 Gherkin mutations, 5 leaked tmux servers, and the observation that the same cleanup idiom recurs in "6+ sibling step-handler files repo-wide".
The specifier accepted the observation and verifi…
